title: Types and extensions in PostgreSQL
brief: Use specialised PostgreSQL types and extensions while owning their installation and operational dependencies.
outcomes: Express overlap and spatial predicates with appropriate types and indexes
Plan extension privileges, restore, upgrade and removal
entry: Typed values, constraints and PostgreSQL operator/index contracts.

heading.title: Types and operators
heading.brief: Follow a specialised value from input through equality, operators and an operator class; distinguish built-in capabilities from separately installed extensions.

heading.title: Ranges and exclusions
heading.brief: Use proposed room bookings with half-open time intervals; express overlap with ranges and GiST exclusion, testing adjacent and conflicting intervals.

heading.title: Spatial questions
heading.brief: Use proposed shop collection points for a distance question; distinguish geometry, geography, units and coordinate systems before a PostGIS index plan.

heading.title: An extension in service
heading.brief: Pin extension versions, dependencies and trusted-install rules; rehearse backup/restore and upgrades, inspect object dependencies and avoid destructive CASCADE as routine removal.
